title: Green beans canned, reduced sodium, cooked, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Canned green beans are selected bean pods that have been blanched, packed in a can with a modest amount of salt and no added fat. The product is ready to eat straight from the jar and retains much of the flavor and texture of fresh beans.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green beans are a good source of plant protein and dietary fiber, making them a nutritious addition to meals.
Reduced‑sodium canning helps lower salt intake without sacrificing taste.
Canning extends shelf life to several years while preserving most of the bean’s nutrients.
Beans provide B‑vitamins, especially folate, which is essential for cell division.
The absence of added fat makes this product suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestive health and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Reduced sodium
items.content: Lower salt content helps manage blood pressure and reduces cardiovascular strain.

items.title: Plant‑based protein source
items.content: Protein from beans aids muscle maintenance, especially in vegetarian diets.

items.title: Contains vitamins and minerals
items.content: Green beans provide vitamin C, vitamin K, iron, and magnesium, important for immunity and metabolism.

items.title: Low‑calorie
items.content: A serving is low in calories, making it convenient for weight management.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to beans.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Although reduced, people on strict sodium limits should account for the amount consumed.

items.title: Bacterial safety
items.content: Damaged cans or improper storage can lead to bacterial growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The beans are ready to eat straight from the can. Add them to salads, soups, stews, pasta dishes, or serve as a side. They can also be quickly warmed in a skillet with herbs for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened cans in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep the beans in a sealed container in the refrigerator and consume within 3–4 days.
